block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: 5-Screen presentation view modes, navigation tabs, and modal states.
what_it_enables: 5 Canonical presentation screens (Tactical, Status, Inventory, World Map, Chronicle)
Top navigation tab bar inside header banner with hotkey bindings (F1-F5)
Dedicated full-canvas viewports for hero dossier, 32-slot inventory, and provincial maps
Idempotent screen switching with zero state mutation
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations during screen switching (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Screen navigation is read-only: switching screens never mutates simulation turn state
All alternate screens strictly honor viewport bounding rectangle

screens.name: Tactical Grid Viewport
screens.description: 2.5D Dimetric and 2D Orthographic tactical battlefield grid with combat vitals.

screens.name: Protagonist Hero Dossier
screens.description: Full protagonist dossier, hex-attributes, stance proficiencies, and titles.

screens.name: Armament & Relic Bag
screens.description: 32-Slot item bag, twin armaments (Shield/Sword), Grandma's Watch, and consumables.

screens.name: Provincial Realm Topology
screens.description: Continental map of Sacyra, Libira, and the Great Mau with travel routes.

screens.name: Historical Deeds Chronicle
screens.description: Narrative chronicle feed, lore compendium chapters, and campaign milestones.

tripwires.action: Ensure exactly 5 presentation screen tabs are registered

tripwires.condition: tab_bar fits completely within header banner panel width
tripwires.action: Clamp tab geometry if header banner boundary is exceeded
